summary.text: Janet Lucas is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 7 who has held the seat since December 4, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An obstetrician and gynecologist, she earned a graduate degree from Ohio State University's College of Medicine.

paragraphs.text: Janet Marie Lucas was born in Ohio and earned a graduate degree from Ohio State University's College of Medicine.
Her career experience includes working as an obstetrician and gynecologist and as a teacher.
Ballotpedia lists her as affiliated with the Pemi River Local Advisory Committee and the Campton Zoning Board of Adjustment.
Lucas assumed office on December 4, 2024, succeeding Tommy Hoyt (D).
